name: ExchangeRate-API
tagline: Currency exchange rates API with free and paid plans for 160+ currencies.
description: ExchangeRate-API provides real-time and historical foreign exchange rates for 160+ currencies. Developers authenticate with an API key and can fetch latest rates, pair conversion, and supported currency lists via REST endpoints. Free tier available with daily request limits; paid plans increase volume and unlock additional features.

auth.details: API key in path: https://v6.exchangerate-api.com/v6/YOUR_API_KEY/... Self-serve signup.

pricing.paid_plans: Paid plans available for higher volume and historical data

use_cases: get latest FX rates for a base currency
convert an amount between two currencies
fetch pair conversion rate (e.g. USD to EUR)
